text:
alex_k: Quick design note — proposing we flatten the current API proxy and adopt a stable facade + many small worker services for routing/telemetry. Rationale: reduces blast radius, makes runtime teams ownership clear, enables aggressive paydown of routing tech-debt.

anya_p: +1 on intent. Concern: auth and request enrichment are duplicated across workers today. How do we avoid repeating that?

kevin_w: Two options: (1) shared auth library (versioned) pulled into workers, (2) small auth-service with strict interface. I prefer (2) for operational observability, but it adds a network hop.

tasha_g: (2) is safer long-term. For perf-critical paths we can allow a cached token in the facade to avoid sync p99 spikes. Also prefer moving telemetry to a separate sidecar worker.

sam_l: Proposal: phased plan with metrics and rollback gates.
Phase A — define facade contract + minimal adapter spec.
Phase B — implement worker prototypes for routing and telemetry in two namespaces, run canary traffic.
Phase C — cutover + migrate teams.
Phase D — deprecate old proxy code.
Metrics: end-to-end p50/p95/p99, error-rate, deploy-blast radius (services impacted), LOC removed.

kevin_w: Example adapter contract (proto-ish):
```json
{
  "path": "/v1/route",
  "method": "POST",
  "schema": {
    "request_id": "string",
    "model": "string",
    "input": "object",
    "auth_token": "string?"
  }
}
```

anya_p: We'll need a clear versioning story: adapter v1, v2, etc. Also migration checklist per team. I'll draft a checklist.

infra-bot: Created canary pool 'worker-refactor-canary' in prod us-west, toggle via infra flag refactor.canary.enabled.

alex_k: Thanks — I'll put a lightweight RFC doc and attach a short migration timeline. Ping me if you want to own a Phase B prototype :thumbsup: @kevin_w @tasha_g
